title: Fix Desktop White Screen From Vitest Module Level Calls
description: The desktop app shows a white screen because compose/js/index.ts has vitest describe/it/expect/beforeAll calls at module level. When the renderer loads @semio-tech/compose-js (via @compose/studio), vitest's getCurrentSuite() throws because there's no test runner. Need to guard all test code so it doesn't execute in browser contexts.
summary: Fixed desktop white screen by guarding all test code in compose/js/index.ts with a vitest environment check. The describe/it/expect/beforeAll calls from vitest were executing at module level when the Electron renderer loaded @semio-tech/compose-js, causing vitest to throw 'failed to find the current suite' since there's no test runner in browser. Moved all test-only imports (vitest, react-dom/server, @elements/ui, @semio-tech/assets, @compose/studio) to dynamic imports inside the guard block. Also fixed 12 missing guid fields on layer attributes in kit_metabolism.json that were added by a concurrent agent. All 79 tests pass.
